title: ononis repens subsp. masquillierii
intro: Ononis repens subsp. masquillierii, commonly known as the Spiny Restharrow, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. It has been reported to possess health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ononis repens subsp. masquillierii are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as isoflavones, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
